rationale: A is clearer and more direct: it keeps one explicit event stream and derives every exposed value from it with small, well-named helpers. B adds an immutable state type and reducer without a meaningful benefit, mutates the wrapper despite claiming the game object is not mutated, and says it replays events when it actually advances state incrementally. B also shadows Python’s built-in reduce name and clamps remaining guesses inconsistently with its loss threshold, while A’s implementation is internally consistent and easier to audit.
